title: governance.fix_available.v1
description: Integration-contract v1 for the fix-available announcement (EDR-INCIDENT-01 D1): a vendor fix is newly on record for CVEs one release has OPEN. One event per release per sweep, gathering Knowledge's per-occurrence knowledge.fix_published.v1 notices. A FACT, not a state change: no Finding, Position or proposal changes. 'Fix available' is the vendor's statement; 'patched' is proven only by new evidence for the release (D5).

CVECount.description: Distinct CVEs over ALL notices of this announcement, not only the carried items.

FindingID.description: Empty when Governance holds no Finding for (release, faultline) yet.
